column1: # Mailboxes (the mod's own block, put there in a Retromon save): x y z, the way its slot faces, whose (player, rival,
# or the words it reads), and a note. Pallet Town's: one block out from each house's front left pillar and one to its
# left, as in HeartGold. Read with SPACE: whose house it is, as FireRed's and HeartGold's.
